text: Birth trauma, which is defined as a structural or functional impairment of a newborn’s body due to mechanical forces sustained during labor, delivery, or neonatal resuscitation [ 1 ], has continued to be a significant source of jeopardy for the neonates and the family and also evokes concerns for healthcare providers [ 2 ].
source_label: Neonatal birth trauma and associated factors in low and middle-income countries: A systematic review and meta-analysis
